presentation.short_description: The board-mounted socket whose contacts connect a processor to power, memory, and system buses.

entities.education_text: A socket fault can affect processor detection, attached memory channels, or inter-processor links even when the processor itself works elsewhere.

presentation.short_description: The connector and board path that power a fan and return tachometer or presence data.

entities.education_text: A spinning fan can still report zero RPM when its sense contact, header, trace, or solder joint is intermittent.

presentation.short_description: The replaceable board that routes PSU output and power-good signals to server subsystems.

entities.education_text: When known-good PSUs fail in every bay, the shared distribution path is a stronger suspect than each supply independently.

entities.description: A historical or cached alert remains visible even though the original fault is gone and fresh hardware state is normal.

presentation.short_description: Magnification and controlled light for inspecting sockets, contacts, connectors, and solder joints.

safety_notes: Use ESD controls before exposing sockets or board assemblies.

presentation.short_description: A controlled driver used to tighten processor and heatsink hardware to the service specification.

safety_notes: Use only the sequence and torque value specified for the exact platform.

presentation.short_description: Approved removable media that runs platform diagnostics or recovery outside the installed operating system.

safety_notes: Verify image authenticity, platform compatibility, and uninterrupted power before use.

presentation.short_description: A temperature-controlled station for qualified connector and board-level solder repair.

safety_notes: Use only at a qualified ESD-safe rework station with the correct process limits.

presentation.short_description: Reads detailed System Event Log entries through an Intelligent Platform Management Interface (IPMI) connection.

illustration.alt_text: Dark service console with abstract List Detailed IPMI System Events output beside enterprise server hardware.
illustration.caption: Canonical command illustration for List Detailed IPMI System Events.
illustration.license_note: Generated for TASK-011 with OpenAI built-in image generation; repository use follows applicable OpenAI terms and the repository license.

entities.purpose: Retrieve timestamped system events with extended sensor context before deciding whether an alert is current or stale.
entities.education_text: Reading a log is non-destructive. Preserve relevant entries before clearing any management state.

presentation.short_description: Reads the Self-Monitoring, Analysis and Reporting Technology (SMART) health log for a Non-Volatile Memory Express (NVMe) device, including warnings, media errors, temperature, and endurance.

illustration.alt_text: Dark service console with abstract Read NVMe Health Log output beside enterprise server hardware.
illustration.caption: Canonical command illustration for Read NVMe Health Log.
illustration.license_note: Generated for TASK-011 with OpenAI built-in image generation; repository use follows applicable OpenAI terms and the repository license.

entities.purpose: Inspect an NVMe device health log without starting a destructive media test.
entities.education_text: Interpret the log with the device and platform documentation; capture it before replacing the drive.

presentation.short_description: Bent, displaced, contaminated, or damaged socket contacts interrupt required processor connections.

entities.education_text: If a known-good processor fails only in one socket, inspect the location before condemning the processor. Fine-pitch contact correction is advanced work; board replacement is the safer service path when correction is not controlled.

presentation.short_description: A connector, tachometer contact, trace, or solder joint intermittently loses fan telemetry.

entities.education_text: When a fault stays with one fan position after fans are swapped, evidence shifts from the fan module to its connector and board path.

presentation.short_description: The shared distribution board cannot route stable power or valid power-good signals.

entities.education_text: A shared PDB can explain why multiple known-good PSUs behave the same in every bay.

presentation.short_description: The embedded management controller cannot initialize normally after firmware corruption or an interrupted update.

entities.education_text: Management-controller failure can affect inventory, remote access, lifecycle tools, boot timing, and failsafe fan control even when the operating system still boots.

presentation.short_description: Interdependent platform firmware versions are mismatched or a new version regresses device behavior.

entities.education_text: Firmware may be the cause rather than the cure. Correlate the first failure with version changes and treat rollback as a controlled repair.

presentation.short_description: An online drive has crossed a health, media-error, or endurance threshold indicating likely failure.

entities.education_text: Predictive failure is actionable before total device loss. Preserve data and controller evidence before replacement.

presentation.short_description: One backplane bay or path cannot power, detect, or communicate with a known-good compatible drive.

entities.education_text: A bay-specific failure should be separated from a failed drive by testing whether the problem follows the media or remains at the location.

presentation.short_description: Management retains an obsolete fault indication after fresh checks show the hardware is healthy.

entities.education_text: A displayed alert is evidence, not automatic proof that its named FRU is currently faulty. Preserve, refresh, and reproduce before replacing hardware.

presentation.short_description: Inspects central processing unit (CPU) socket contact alignment, contamination, damage, and mounting evidence under controlled magnification.

illustration.alt_text: Night-shift server test setup for Magnified CPU Socket Inspection, staged without indicating a result.
illustration.caption: Canonical test illustration for Magnified CPU Socket Inspection.
illustration.license_note: Generated for TASK-011 with OpenAI built-in image generation; repository use follows applicable OpenAI terms and the repository license.

evidence_rules.notes: Visible displaced, contaminated, or damaged contacts can confirm a physical socket fault; a normal visual result may remain inconclusive for microscopic contact problems.

entities.education_text: Compare the uniform contact pattern from multiple angles and do not touch contacts during an inspection-only test.

presentation.short_description: Temporarily swaps compatible fans between documented locations to learn whether a telemetry fault follows the fan or remains at its connector.

illustration.alt_text: Night-shift server test setup for Fan-to-Location Cross-Substitution, staged without indicating a result.
illustration.caption: Canonical test illustration for Fan-to-Location Cross-Substitution.
illustration.license_note: Generated for TASK-011 with OpenAI built-in image generation; repository use follows applicable OpenAI terms and the repository license.

evidence_rules.notes: The fault staying at one location supports the connector path; following one fan supports the fan module instead. Temporary substitutions revert after comparison.
The fault following one fan supports a failed fan module.

entities.education_text: This is a diagnostic substitution, not a permanent replacement. Restore the original machine state after the comparison.

presentation.short_description: Compares known-good power supply units (PSUs) across supported bays and minimum configuration to isolate a shared power-distribution fault.

illustration.alt_text: Night-shift server test setup for Power Distribution Path Isolation, staged without indicating a result.
illustration.caption: Canonical test illustration for Power Distribution Path Isolation.
illustration.license_note: Generated for TASK-011 with OpenAI built-in image generation; repository use follows applicable OpenAI terms and the repository license.

evidence_rules.notes: The same power-good or shutdown failure with a known-good supply in every supported bay supports the shared distribution path.
A successful known-good substitution can rule out the original PSU without permanently installing it.

entities.education_text: Do not live-probe undocumented connectors. Follow the platform service procedure and de-energization requirements.

presentation.short_description: Determines whether the baseboard management controller (BMC) is reachable, resettable, in recovery mode, or unrecoverable.

illustration.alt_text: Night-shift server test setup for BMC Recovery-State Test, staged without indicating a result.
illustration.caption: Canonical test illustration for BMC Recovery-State Test.
illustration.license_note: Generated for TASK-011 with OpenAI built-in image generation; repository use follows applicable OpenAI terms and the repository license.

evidence_rules.notes: Failure across approved reset and recovery entry paths supports an unrecoverable embedded-controller state; successful reset rules out persistent corruption.

entities.education_text: Test reachability and approved recovery paths before treating the entire system board as failed.

presentation.short_description: Compares basic input/output system (BIOS), baseboard management controller (BMC), storage, network, and device firmware with an approved compatible baseline.

illustration.alt_text: Night-shift server test setup for Firmware Version Compatibility Review, staged without indicating a result.
illustration.caption: Canonical test illustration for Firmware Version Compatibility Review.
illustration.license_note: Generated for TASK-011 with OpenAI built-in image generation; repository use follows applicable OpenAI terms and the repository license.

evidence_rules.notes: A documented incompatible combination or repeatable regression correlated with a version change can confirm the fault.

entities.education_text: Newest is not automatically safest; use the platform dependency order, release notes, and recovery plan.

presentation.short_description: Reviews Self-Monitoring, Analysis and Reporting Technology (SMART), controller, media-error, and endurance data before an online drive fails completely.

illustration.alt_text: Night-shift server test setup for Predictive Drive Health Analysis, staged without indicating a result.
illustration.caption: Canonical test illustration for Predictive Drive Health Analysis.
illustration.license_note: Generated for TASK-011 with OpenAI built-in image generation; repository use follows applicable OpenAI terms and the repository license.

evidence_rules.notes: A controller predictive flag, critical SMART warning, persistent media-error trend, or exhausted endurance can confirm the fault.

entities.education_text: Capture the device serial, bay, controller log, and health data before replacement. Avoid destructive tests before data protection.

presentation.short_description: Uses protected inventory and compatible known-good media to learn whether a storage failure follows a drive or remains at one bay or backplane path.

illustration.alt_text: Night-shift server test setup for Drive Bay Path Isolation, staged without indicating a result.
illustration.caption: Canonical test illustration for Drive Bay Path Isolation.
illustration.license_note: Generated for TASK-011 with OpenAI built-in image generation; repository use follows applicable OpenAI terms and the repository license.

evidence_rules.notes: A compatible known-good test drive missing only from one bay supports the bay/backplane path. Temporary test media is removed after comparison.
A failure that follows the original drive supports media failure instead of the bay path.

entities.education_text: Protect array metadata and slot mapping. Never move production members casually to perform this test.

presentation.short_description: Preserves current management logs, refreshes controller state, and checks whether the target alert returns under the complaint conditions.

illustration.alt_text: Night-shift server test setup for Event Log Freshness Test, staged without indicating a result.
illustration.caption: Canonical test illustration for Event Log Freshness Test.
illustration.license_note: Generated for TASK-011 with OpenAI built-in image generation; repository use follows applicable OpenAI terms and the repository license.

evidence_rules.notes: A historical alert that does not recur after evidence preservation, refresh, and a relevant retest supports stale state rather than a current FRU fault.

entities.education_text: Preserve evidence before clearing. A cleared display alone is not proof; exercise the relevant machine state again.

presentation.short_description: Observes Ethernet link transitions and interface error counters over a defined interval after a firmware-related change.

illustration.alt_text: Night-shift server test setup for Network Link and Counter Soak, staged without indicating a result.
illustration.caption: Canonical test illustration for Network Link and Counter Soak.
illustration.license_note: Generated for TASK-011 with OpenAI built-in image generation; repository use follows applicable OpenAI terms and the repository license.

evidence_rules.notes: Flapping that appears with one firmware set and disappears with an approved rollback supports a regression; persistent physical errors shift attention to the link path.

entities.education_text: Define the observation interval and acceptance counters before starting so absence of a brief alert is not mistaken for proof.

presentation.short_description: Safely removes external power, discharges residual state, and controls re-energization before internal service.

entities.purpose: Prevent unintended energization and give embedded controllers and stored energy the documented discharge interval before service.
entities.education_text: Use the exact platform service instructions; removing one PSU may not de-energize a redundant server.

presentation.display_name: CPU Socket Handling and Torque Protocol
presentation.short_description: Controls socket exposure, contact inspection, processor alignment, and model-specified tightening sequence.

entities.purpose: Prevent new contact damage and uneven loading while inspecting or servicing a processor socket.
entities.education_text: Fine-pitch socket work is platform-specific and qualification-gated. Install the protective cover whenever the socket is stored empty.

presentation.short_description: Controls compatibility review, dependency order, backup, power protection, rollback, and recovery for firmware work.

entities.purpose: Reduce firmware-induced outages and ensure every change has an approved image, compatible sequence, evidence capture, and recovery path.
entities.education_text: Do not interrupt power or assume the newest image is compatible with every adjacent controller.

presentation.display_name: Storage Data Preservation and Member Replacement Protocol
presentation.short_description: Protects data, array metadata, serial-to-bay mapping, and rebuild state during drive or backplane service.

entities.purpose: Prevent avoidable data loss while identifying, replacing, and validating storage FRUs.
entities.education_text: Record the exact serial and bay, secure a current backup when possible, and never assume a rebuild has started or finished.

presentation.short_description: Controls ESD, heat, materials, inspection, and acceptance for connector-level solder repair.

entities.purpose: Limit board-level repair to qualified work with controlled materials, temperatures, inspection, cleaning, and verification.
entities.education_text: If the repair process or acceptance criteria are unavailable, replace the supported FRU instead of improvising a board repair.

presentation.short_description: Defines evidence capture, complaint reproduction, state refresh, stress or soak, and documented exit criteria.

entities.purpose: Ensure that no-trouble-found means the reported condition was systematically exercised and documented, not merely absent during a brief power-on.
entities.education_text: Record received and returned configuration, conditions attempted, elapsed soak, evidence retained, and limitations.

presentation.short_description: A qualified repair restores correct socket contact condition or replaces the supported board FRU.

steps_summary: De-energize and expose the socket under ESD control.
Use the approved qualified contact-correction process, or replace the supported system-board FRU.
Install the processor and heatsink with the specified sequence and torque.
entities.education_text: Do not attempt fine-pitch contact correction without the correct service process, magnification, and qualification.

presentation.short_description: A qualified board repair restores the connector or sense joint, or the supported board FRU is replaced.

steps_summary: De-energize and inspect the connector path.
Rework the confirmed joint under the qualified process, or replace the supported board FRU.
Clean and inspect the repaired area before reassembly.
entities.education_text: Pressure that temporarily changes the symptom is diagnostic evidence, not a durable repair.

presentation.short_description: Replaces the isolated PDB or PSU-backplane FRU and restores its supported connections.

steps_summary: Remove all input power and observe the discharge interval.
Record and disconnect the PDB power and signal paths.
Install the compatible replacement and restore every connection before re-energizing.
entities.education_text: A PDB replacement changes machine state but does not prove stable power until cold-start and redundancy checks pass.

presentation.short_description: Uses the approved reset or recovery image path and escalates to board replacement when the embedded controller is unrecoverable.

steps_summary: Preserve available logs, identity, license, and configuration data.
Apply the platform-approved reset or recovery method with the correct image and protected power.
If recovery cannot initialize, replace the supported board FRU and restore identity and configuration.
entities.education_text: Recovery steps are ordered and platform-specific; repeated incompatible flashing can make evidence and recovery worse.

presentation.short_description: Updates or rolls back interdependent firmware to an approved, compatible version set.

steps_summary: Capture the current version set and failure correlation.
Select the approved compatible target and dependency order.
Apply the controlled update or rollback and complete all pending jobs and required restarts.
entities.education_text: Firmware repair must preserve a rollback or recovery route and must not be represented as indiscriminate updating.

presentation.short_description: Protects data, identifies the exact drive, replaces it safely, and starts the required rebuild or initialization.

steps_summary: Protect current data and capture the drive serial, bay, and controller evidence.
Follow the controller-safe offline or hot-swap procedure for the exact member.
Install a compatible replacement and confirm that rebuild or initialization starts.
entities.education_text: Replacement is incomplete until the new member and array return to their required healthy states.

presentation.short_description: Replaces an isolated backplane while preserving drive order, controller metadata, and cabling.

steps_summary: Capture drive serial-to-bay mapping and array state.
De-energize as required and replace the compatible backplane without changing drive order.
Restore cables and handle any foreign configuration only through the approved controller procedure.
entities.education_text: A backplane replacement should not silently reorder members or overwrite controller metadata.

presentation.short_description: After preserving evidence, refreshes or clears obsolete management state so current hardware can be evaluated.

steps_summary: Export the relevant event and hardware state evidence.
Use the approved management refresh, log-clear, or controller-reset operation.
Re-exercise the complaint conditions without replacing the healthy FRU.
entities.education_text: Clearing an alert changes reported state; only a clean retest verifies that the alert was stale.

presentation.short_description: Cold-starts the server and verifies the expected processors, memory channels, and dependent devices.

success_conditions: The server completes repeated cold POST cycles without the original processor or memory symptom.
Every expected processor and attached memory channel appears in platform inventory.
No new socket, CPU, or memory-channel event is recorded.
entities.education_text: One successful warm boot is weak proof for a contact fault; include cold cycles and full inventory.

presentation.short_description: Confirms stable fan presence and RPM telemetry through cold cycles and controlled load.

success_conditions: The repaired location reports plausible stable RPM after repeated cold starts.
The fan-control response remains normal during controlled load.
No fan-presence, tachometer, or redundancy event recurs.
entities.education_text: Validate both physical rotation and telemetry; either one alone can miss the original failure mode.

presentation.short_description: Verifies cold starts, stable rails, PSU-bay operation, and redundancy after PDB replacement.

success_conditions: The server completes repeated cold starts without voltage or power-good faults.
Each supported PSU bay reports correct presence and input/output telemetry.
A safe redundancy transition does not interrupt operation or create a new power event.
entities.education_text: A restored power-on proves less than stable distribution and redundancy under the supported configuration.

presentation.short_description: Checks BMC access, sensors, inventory, lifecycle functions, and cold initialization after recovery.

success_conditions: The BMC becomes ready after repeated cold initialization.
Authorized UI, API, or CLI access succeeds and inventory and sensor readings are plausible.
Lifecycle functions are available and no initialization or failsafe-fan event recurs.
entities.education_text: An operating-system boot does not by itself verify the embedded management controller.

presentation.short_description: Confirms the intended version set persists and affected devices initialize without the regression.

success_conditions: The approved version set is present after a cold restart with no pending or failed jobs.
Affected devices and drivers initialize with expected inventory and settings.
The defined link/counter soak completes without the original regression or new firmware event.
entities.education_text: Verify both version persistence and the behavior that motivated the change.

presentation.short_description: Confirms the correct replacement member, healthy array state, and clean predictive status.

success_conditions: The expected replacement serial appears in the documented bay.
Required rebuild, initialization, or consistency work completes and the virtual disk is healthy.
No predictive warning or new media/path error appears during the defined observation period.
entities.education_text: A green bay light or started rebuild is not the same as completed storage recovery.

presentation.short_description: Confirms every expected bay, drive, and array member remains stable after backplane replacement.

success_conditions: All expected bays and drive serials are detected in their documented locations.
The array imports or remains online without unexpected foreign or missing members.
A non-destructive storage soak produces no new bay, link, or I/O errors.
entities.education_text: Verify location mapping as well as aggregate array health after changing the shared drive path.

presentation.short_description: Re-exercises the complaint conditions after state refresh and requires no new target alert.

success_conditions: The relevant complaint conditions and hardware checks are completed after the preserved baseline is cleared or refreshed.
The implicated hardware remains healthy in current inventory and telemetry.
No new target event appears during the documented observation window.
entities.education_text: Document the duration and conditions. No recurrence during an undefined brief check is weak evidence.
